title: The Autumn of Break-Ups
cn: 第 5 集 · 分手之秋
novel: Ted and Victoria had to choose their next step in their relationship. They had been together for a while and things were getting serious. Victoria wanted Ted to make a [[commitment|commitment]] to her. She felt that their relationship was not moving forward. Ted was [[hesitant|hesitant]] because he was still thinking about Robin. He knew it was not fair to Victoria to keep her waiting. They had a long conversation about their future together. Victoria told Ted that she needed to know where they stood. Ted finally [[admitted|admit]] that he was not ready to fully commit. Victoria was [[disappointed|disappoint]] but said she understood. They decided to end their relationship [[amicably|amicable]]. Meanwhile, Robin worried about Barney choosing a dog as his wingman. Barney had gotten a dog and started bringing it to bars to attract women. Robin was [[jealous|jealous]] because she still had feelings for Barney. She tried to [[discourage|discourage]] him from using the dog as a [[tool|tool]] for picking up women. She said it was [[cruel|cruel]] to use an animal for personal gain. Barney [[ignored|ignore]] her complaints and continued his scheme. Robin finally told Barney how she felt about the dog and about him. Barney was [[surprised|surprised]] by her honesty and started to rethink his approach.

disappoint.en: to feel sad when let down

tool.en: something used to achieve a goal
